# Sierra Monitor is now SMC

[MSA The Safety Company | FieldServer | SMC logo]

Things at Sierra Monitor Corporation may look a bit different. But rest assured, our innovative
spirit, the quality products that you depend on and that same level of exceptional service you have
come to expect, remains unchanged.

#### FieldServer Automation Gateways

The FieldServer suite of automation gateway products is quietly at work on site or in the cloud at
over 100,000 locations around the world. The comfort and safety of millions of people depends daily
on FieldServer devices as they enter corporate, educational, medical, entertainment, industrial and
other facilities in major cities and at some of the most remote locations on earth.

[Explore FieldServer Solutions][106]

#### SMC Gas Detection

SMC detection solutions address the facilities safety segment. Our SMC branded controllers, sensor
modules, and software are used by safety managers to protect facility personnel and assets across
thousands of facilities such as natural gas vehicle fueling and maintenance stations, wastewater
treatment plants, parking garages, and underground telephone vaults.

[Explore SMC Gas Detection][107]

# Passion for Photonics

Advanced Photonix provides innovative photonics, optoelectronics and advanced electronic systems for
Aerospace & Defence, Medical, Agricultural, and Industrial Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs)
who demand high reliability, high-performance and market-driven technology solutions today.

# Our Products

#### Photodiodes

Our high-performance photodiodes and optical sensors are trusted by Aerospace and Defense, Medical &
Life Sciences, Test and Measurement, and Industrial markets.

[View Product][25]

#### Photodiode Modules

Experience the ultimate in evaluation technology with our state-of-the-art modules that seamlessly
integrate high-performance electronics with our superior photodiodes and optical sensors.

[View Product][26]

#### Light Dependent Resistor (LDR)

Light Dependent Resistors (LDR) measure visible light between 400 and 700nm. The resistance
decreases as light increases, with efficiency similar to the human eye.

[View Product][27]

#### Optocouplers / Optoisolators

Our CdS Photocell Output Optocouplers or Optoisolators are designed to connect an LED to a CdS LDR
optically. This connection allows two electric circuits to interconnect through a light-sensitive
optical interface. 

[View Product][28]

#### Optical Switches / Opto Switches

Slotted optical switches, also known as Opto Switches, consist of an infrared emitting diode and an
NPN silicon phototransistor housed in a single package. These switches are commonly used in various
instruments, systems, and equipment to indicate status when light beams are interrupted.

[View Product][29]

# Passion for Photonics

Advanced Photonix provides innovative photonics, optoelectronics and advanced electronic systems for
Aerospace & Defence, Medical, Agricultural, and Industrial Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs)
who demand high reliability, high-performance and market-driven technology solutions today.

# Our Products

#### Photodiodes

Our high-performance photodiodes and optical sensors are trusted by Aerospace and Defense, Medical &
Life Sciences, Test and Measurement, and Industrial markets.

[View Product][25]

#### Photodiode Modules

Experience the ultimate in evaluation technology with our state-of-the-art modules that seamlessly
integrate high-performance electronics with our superior photodiodes and optical sensors.

[View Product][26]

#### Light Dependent Resistor (LDR)

Light Dependent Resistors (LDR) measure visible light between 400 and 700nm. The resistance
decreases as light increases, with efficiency similar to the human eye.

[View Product][27]

#### Optocouplers / Optoisolators

Our CdS Photocell Output Optocouplers or Optoisolators are designed to connect an LED to a CdS LDR
optically. This connection allows two electric circuits to interconnect through a light-sensitive
optical interface. 

[View Product][28]

#### Optical Switches / Opto Switches

Slotted optical switches, also known as Opto Switches, consist of an infrared emitting diode and an
NPN silicon phototransistor housed in a single package. These switches are commonly used in various
instruments, systems, and equipment to indicate status when light beams are interrupted.

# Albis Optoelectronics - *Detecting Solutions*

## [Applications][38]

Our advanced photodiode solutions cover a variety of applications, including optical communications,
monitoring and sensing, quantum computing, microwave photonic links, and test and measurement.

[Read More][39]

## [Products][40]

Choose your photodiode from a vast catalogue of single-channel and array options, available as bare
die, on carriers, or packaged - covering all datacom and telecom wavelengths and speeds up to 200G.

[Read More][41]

## [Fab Services][42]

With our world-class on-site wafer manufacturing and testing facilities, including cleanrooms,
assembly and packaging capabilities, and reliability labs, we offer various custom fab services.

[Read More][43]

#### Albis Optoelectronics

Albis Optoelectronics is a leading designer, developer and manufacturer of high-speed photodiode
chips. The company offers a diversified product portfolio consisting of InP and GaAs based PIN
photodiodes, APDs and high speed detector modules. These photodiode products are completely
manufactured in-house in fully owned clean-room facilities.

#### Meet us

You are always welcome
to visit us at our headquarters!

We Are:
Independent & National

We Are:

* A member searching for guidance

We Are:
Transparent & Flexible
[plus] [minus]

We Are:
Cost Containment Solutionists
[plus] [minus]

Our data-driven strategies combine advanced analytics and strategic partnerships to help you reduce
costs without sacrificing care.

From proactive and empathetic medical management to targeted and proven cost-containment strategies,
we ensure every healthcare dollar is spent wisely.

We Are:
Holistically Member-Centric
[plus] [minus]

Our personalized healthcare solutions redefine what it means to care for a workforce.

Through intuitive digital tools and our industry-leading member services team, we support employees
at every healthcare touchpoint—making it easier to find care, navigate claims, and achieve better
health outcomes.

###### What We Do

## Care at the Core.
## Strategy in Every Detail

Allied offers a full spectrum of services designed to streamline administration, improve outcomes,
and **make self-funded health plans work better for everyone.**

###### We Offer:

## Self-Funded Strategies

Empower your organization with flexible, unbundled plan design—pairing the freedom to choose leading
networks, PBMs, and point solutions with robust medical management expertise and self-funded
strategies shaped by over 45 years of independent administration experience.

[Build Self-Funded Strategies][41]

###### We Offer:

## Admin Services

Simplify health plan administration with efficient claims processing, expert compliance guidance,
and seamless day-to-day management from a trusted team.

[Explore Administrative Services][42]

###### We Offer:

## Care Solutions

Keep members engaged and healthy with URAC-accredited medical management and cost-containment
programs. Integrate additional innovative behavioral health and wellness packages, all tailored to
today’s modern workforce.

[Learn More About Care Solutions][43]

###### We Offer:

## Analytics

Use data to drive smarter decisions with intuitive reporting tools that give you the clarity and
confidence to act.

[Discover Allied Analytics][44]

###### We Offer:

## Allied Digital

Redefine the healthcare management experience with intuitive digital tools, virtual primary care,
and personalized care navigation for members and their families.

[See Allied Digital in Action][45]

###### Who We Serve:

## Carefully Connecting Every Corner of Healthcare

Allied works with benefits consultants, employers, members, and providers to create a seamless
healthcare management experience. Whether you’re guiding clients, designing plans, navigating care,
or delivering it, we’re here to provide the tools and support you need to succeed.

[Consultants]

###### We Serve:

## Benefits Consultants

Provide your clients with an independent, data-driven TPA solution—without sacrificing flexibility
or quality. Our transparent approach keeps you in the loop, ensuring you’re always the go-to
resource for your clients.

[Partner with Allied][46]
[Employers]

###### We Serve:

## Employers

Harness the power of a self-funded model or transition from carrier-based self-funding to a truly
independent partner. We work together with you and your benefits consultant to design sustainable
health plans that retain talent and respect your budget.

[Transform Your Healthcare Benefits][47]
[Members]

###### We Serve:

## Members

Get the coverage, support, and resources you need—anytime. Whether it’s finding a provider,
understanding a claim, or accessing mental health and wellness programs, we’re here to guide you
toward healthier outcomes with a simpler healthcare management experience.

[Member Portal Login][48]
[Providers]

###### We Serve:

## Providers

Simplify your workflow with digital tools that provide immediate access to member claim and
eligibility status, deductible and out-of-pocket information, ID card images, plan information, and
more.

[Access Provider Tools][49]

###### How We Deliver

## The Measurable Impact of Care

Care isn’t just a promise—it’s a measurable impact. From happier members to smarter spending, these
numbers show the difference self-funding with Allied makes.

###### $192M

#### 2025 net estimated savings from Allied cost management strategies.

###### $28M

#### 2025 total Case Management savings. 

###### $25.4M

#### 2025 total estimated savings from Enhanced Case Management strategies.

###### $15.6M

#### in inpatient medical costs avoided through Utilization Review in 2025.

###### $9.2M

#### in outpatient medical costs avoided through Utilization Review in 2025.

###### 76.9%

#### average savings from billed charges on claims managed through Allied Advocate in 2025.

###### 12.2:1

#### average Utilization Management return on investment in 2025.

###### 12.6:1

#### average Case Management return on investment in 2025.

###### 2:1

#### average Enhanced Case Management return on investment in 2025.

###### 2,133

#### hospital days avoided through acute inpatient Utilization Review in 2025.

###### 1.5:1

#### average Oncology+ program return on investment in 2025.

###### What's Next?

## Bringing Care and Strategy Together

A better benefits strategy starts with a clear plan. Whether you’re guiding clients or leading an
organization, Allied’s collaborative approach makes self-funding seamless and effective.

 

[Consult & Customize]

###### 1. Consult & Customize

We begin by understanding the unique goals and challenges of your organization or client. From
workforce demographics to priorities like mental health and wellness, we discuss self-funded
strategies that help you achieve success while ensuring members feel supported and cared for.

[Implement & Optimize]

###### 2. Implement & Optimize

Using our exclusive partnerships—including network access, stop-loss coverage, PBM services, and
innovative point solutions—we build transparent self-funded plans that deliver real value. These
plans ensure members have access to quality care, essential resources and a seamless healthcare
management experience.

[Manage & Grow]

###### 3. Manage & Grow

With ongoing data insights and dedicated support, we continuously refine your health plan offerings
to meet evolving needs. This process drives better member outcomes by improving access to care,
prompting well-being, and reducing unnecessary costs.

[Rethink traditional]

## Rethink traditional healthcare benefits.

With Allied, you don't have to compromise. You get expectational care, controlled costs, and a clear
strategy that works for everyone—today and tomorrow.

[Let’s Get Started][50]

###### Who We Are

## The Partner That Prioritizes Care

Choosing the right administration partner is more than checking boxes—it’s identifying a team that
can create tailored solutions, drive real results, and prioritize care at every turn.

 

We Are:
Independent & National
[plus] [minus]

As the largest independent TPA in the U.S., with over 45 years of expertise and nationwide reach,
we’re free to focus on what matters most: **creating custom healthcare solutions that
prioritize member care.**

Unencumbered by the constraints of insurance companies or large health systems, we tailor every
solution to your unique needs.

We Are:
Industry Experts
[plus] [minus]

With decades of experience navigating the ever-changing healthcare landscape, we bring unparalleled
expertise to every partnership.

Whether you’re:
* A Broker seeking innovative strategies,
* An employer looking to deliver quality care while managing costs effectively, or
* A member searching for guidance

We provide the solution and support needed to achieve better outcomes at every level.

We Are:
Transparent & Flexible
[plus] [minus]

Tired of hidden costs and rigid policies? Our custom plan designs and transparent reporting give you
full control of your benefits strategy.

With Allied, your plan is flexible and built to adapt to your workforce’s evolving needs.

We Are:
Cost Containment Solutionists
[plus] [minus]

Our data-driven strategies combine advanced analytics and strategic partnerships to help you reduce
costs without sacrificing care.

From proactive and empathetic medical management to targeted and proven cost-containment strategies,
we ensure every healthcare dollar is spent wisely.

We Are:
Holistically Member-Centric
[plus] [minus]

Our personalized healthcare solutions redefine what it means to care for a workforce.

Through intuitive digital tools and our industry-leading member services team, we support employees
at every healthcare touchpoint—making it easier to find care, navigate claims, and achieve better
health outcomes.

###### What We Do

## Care at the Core.
## Strategy in Every Detail

Allied offers a full spectrum of services designed to streamline administration, improve outcomes,
and **make self-funded health plans work better for everyone.**

###### We Offer:

## Self-Funded Strategies

Empower your organization with flexible, unbundled plan design—pairing the freedom to choose leading
networks, PBMs, and point solutions with robust medical management expertise and self-funded
strategies shaped by over 45 years of independent administration experience.

[Build Self-Funded Strategies][41]

###### We Offer:

## Admin Services

Simplify health plan administration with efficient claims processing, expert compliance guidance,
and seamless day-to-day management from a trusted team.

[Explore Administrative Services][42]

###### We Offer:

## Care Solutions

Keep members engaged and healthy with URAC-accredited medical management and cost-containment
programs. Integrate additional innovative behavioral health and wellness packages, all tailored to
today’s modern workforce.

[Learn More About Care Solutions][43]

###### We Offer:

## Analytics

Use data to drive smarter decisions with intuitive reporting tools that give you the clarity and
confidence to act.

[Discover Allied Analytics][44]

###### We Offer:

## Allied Digital

Redefine the healthcare management experience with intuitive digital tools, virtual primary care,
and personalized care navigation for members and their families.

[See Allied Digital in Action][45]

###### Who We Serve:

## Carefully Connecting Every Corner of Healthcare

Allied works with benefits consultants, employers, members, and providers to create a seamless
healthcare management experience. Whether you’re guiding clients, designing plans, navigating care,
or delivering it, we’re here to provide the tools and support you need to succeed.

[Consultants]

###### We Serve:

## Benefits Consultants

Provide your clients with an independent, data-driven TPA solution—without sacrificing flexibility
or quality. Our transparent approach keeps you in the loop, ensuring you’re always the go-to
resource for your clients.

[Partner with Allied][46]
[Employers]

###### We Serve:

## Employers

Harness the power of a self-funded model or transition from carrier-based self-funding to a truly
independent partner. We work together with you and your benefits consultant to design sustainable
health plans that retain talent and respect your budget.

[Transform Your Healthcare Benefits][47]
[Members]

###### We Serve:

## Members

Get the coverage, support, and resources you need—anytime. Whether it’s finding a provider,
understanding a claim, or accessing mental health and wellness programs, we’re here to guide you
toward healthier outcomes with a simpler healthcare management experience.

[Member Portal Login][48]
[Providers]

###### We Serve:

## Providers

Simplify your workflow with digital tools that provide immediate access to member claim and
eligibility status, deductible and out-of-pocket information, ID card images, plan information, and
more.

[Access Provider Tools][49]

###### How We Deliver

## The Measurable Impact of Care

Care isn’t just a promise—it’s a measurable impact. From happier members to smarter spending, these
numbers show the difference self-funding with Allied makes.

#### 2025 net estimated savings from Allied cost management strategies.

###### $28M

#### 2025 total Case Management savings. 

###### $25.4M

#### 2025 total estimated savings from Enhanced Case Management strategies.

###### $15.6M

#### in inpatient medical costs avoided through Utilization Review in 2025.

###### $9.2M

#### in outpatient medical costs avoided through Utilization Review in 2025.

###### 76.9%

#### average savings from billed charges on claims managed through Allied Advocate in 2025.

###### 12.2:1

#### average Utilization Management return on investment in 2025.

###### 12.6:1

#### average Case Management return on investment in 2025.

###### 2:1

#### average Enhanced Case Management return on investment in 2025.

###### 2,133

#### hospital days avoided through acute inpatient Utilization Review in 2025.

###### 1.5:1

#### average Oncology+ program return on investment in 2025.

###### What's Next?

## Bringing Care and Strategy Together

A better benefits strategy starts with a clear plan. Whether you’re guiding clients or leading an
organization, Allied’s collaborative approach makes self-funding seamless and effective.

 

[Consult & Customize]

###### 1. Consult & Customize

We begin by understanding the unique goals and challenges of your organization or client. From
workforce demographics to priorities like mental health and wellness, we discuss self-funded
strategies that help you achieve success while ensuring members feel supported and cared for.

[Implement & Optimize]

###### 2. Implement & Optimize

Using our exclusive partnerships—including network access, stop-loss coverage, PBM services, and
innovative point solutions—we build transparent self-funded plans that deliver real value. These
plans ensure members have access to quality care, essential resources and a seamless healthcare
management experience.

[Manage & Grow]

###### 3. Manage & Grow

With ongoing data insights and dedicated support, we continuously refine your health plan offerings
to meet evolving needs. This process drives better member outcomes by improving access to care,
prompting well-being, and reducing unnecessary costs.

[Rethink traditional]

## Rethink traditional healthcare benefits.

With Allied, you don't have to compromise. You get expectational care, controlled costs, and a clear
strategy that works for everyone—today and tomorrow.

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

### APIs

[Find out more][139]

We understand what is at stake in your API program and bring decades of experience in development
and manufacturing to ensure a reliable, high-quality drug substance supply that keeps your project
progressing with confidence.

Our API development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* [**Peptides**][140]
* [**PepCellerate™ FIH Peptide-Injectable Clinical Trial Supply**][141]
* [**Tag-Assisted Peptide Synthesis (TAPS)**][142]
* [**Oligonucleotides**][143]
* [**HPAPIs**][144]
* [**Small Molecules**][145]
* [**API Support Services**][146] (Flow Chemistry, Crystallization, Solid Forms,
  Polymorphism, Purification Services)

### Drug Products

[Find out more][147]

Our broad spectrum of drug product capabilities spans from clinical development through
commercialization across a wide range of dosage forms, including Oral Solid Dosage
(OSD), Aseptic Fill and Finish sterile injectables, and Oral Peptide Delivery, covering multiple
modalities, including highly potent compounds. With advanced packaging, labeling, and serialization
capabilities, we deliver reliable, high-quality drug product supply to support your program at every
stage. 

Our Drug Product development & manufacturing capabilities include:
* **Non-Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * [**Oral Solid Dose**][148]
  * [**Non-Sterile Liquids**][149]
  * [**Rectal Dosage Forms**][150]
* **Sterile Dosage Forms**
  * **[Aseptic Fill & Finish][151]  **
  * [**Sterile Liquids**][152]
  * [**Sterile Powder-Lyophilized Vials**][153]
* [**Drug Product Specialities**][154]
  * [**Bioavailability Enhancement**][155]
  * [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][156]
  * [**Oral Peptide Delivery**][157]
* **Packaging**
  * [**Pharma Packaging Services**][158]

### Lipid Excipients & Nanomedicines

[Find out more][159]

We are a global CDMO leader in pioneering specialized lipid-based products, supporting the
development and manufacturing of nanomedicines with expertise in synthetic lipid process
development, LNP formulation, scale-up, and large-scale manufacturing. Our high-quality lipid
excipient building blocks, LNP starter kits, and cutting-edge technologies support your supply of
lipid-based medicines, no matter the scale or phase of development. 

Our Lipid Excipient and Nanomedicine capabilities include:
* [**LNP Formulation Development & Manufacturing**][160]
* [**LNP Starter Kits**][161]
* [**Custom Lipid Manufacturing**][162]
* [**Standard Lipids Catalog**][163]
* **[Lipid Excipient Technologies][164] **(ADME & DMPK, SORT-Coated LNPs)

### True End-to-End Supply

Managing multiple CDMOs across development stages and technologies increases coordination effort,
risk, and timelines. CordenPharma integrates development and manufacturing of complex modalities
across APIs, Drug Products and Packaging at all scales, coordinated through a global delivery and
project management model.

**What this means for you: **
* Fewer handovers between suppliers and project phases
* Clear accountability across development and manufacturing activities
* Better visibility and control from early development through commercial supply

Our Advantages
Dongguan Fortuna is a production enterprise specializing in precision metal stamping parts,
precision CNC processing, injection molding and product assembly.
[
][124]
[Design and R&D capabilities][125]
Our factory has strong design and R&D capability and 8 R&D personnel responsible for mold design and
technical evaluation with more than 10 years of experience in the stamping and CNC filed.
[
][126]
[one-stop service][127]
Fortuna has its own complete quality control system for strictly controling the quality of all
finished products and a favorable product delivery time, ensuring satisfactory one-stop service for
customers.
[
][128]
[Meet Needs][129]
Fortuna currently has 85 sets of punching machines tonnage from 25T to 300T and 42 imported Japanese
CNC lathes, which can fully meet the diverse requirements of customer products .
[
][130]
[Advanced Eouipment ][131]
With the introduction of low-speed wire cutting machines (MITSUBISHI SEI BU), milling machines,
grinding machines and other equipment, we are able to produce a variety of hard and high-precision
metal-grade progressive dies with stable quality.
[
][132]
[Quality Control Committed to 0PPM ][133]
We have established a rigorous quality management system that spans the entire process. Through
advanced testing equipment and a continuously improving quality management system, we provide our
customers with stable, reliable, and high-quality products.

Custom Service

Fortuna has its own processing equipment for independent product processing, production and
inspection, which greatly speeds up delivery and enhances quality control. It also boasts a
reputable professional after-sales team offering comprehensive services for metal stamping parts.

Advantages of Cooperation
Experienced designers and advanced CNC equipment together ensure the production of high-quality

design to delivery.
[
][150]

Designers with over 10 years of experience in mold design and manufacturing.
[
][152]
[Product Customization][153]
Experienced in designing and manufacturing various components, including terminals, shells, and
springs.
[
][154]
[Paperless office and visual management][155]
Fortuna fully implements digital processes and real-time visual management, covering every stage
from order to delivery, improving collaboration efficiency and ensuring qualified delivery to
customers.
[
][156]
[Production Equipment and Quality][157]
All mold components are machined using CNC, with high-quality materials such as D2, SKD11, and
carbide.
[
][158]
[Development Capability][159]
Capable of completing mold design, machining, assembly, and testing in-house.

Custom  Products

As a leading manufacturer, Fortuna produces the custom precision metal stamping parts, widely used
in home appliance, communication equipment, auto parts, new energy vehicles and Telecommunications,
Robots, and Sensors. Product quality and affordable price won the praise of customers. Products are
exported to Japan, USA, Germany, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Norway and other  countries.

supply core metal components for various robotic applications, ensuring the reliability and accuracy

Dongguan Fortuna is a production enterprise specializing in precision metal stamping parts,

With the introduction of low-speed wire cutting machines (MITSUBISHI SEI BU), milling machines,
grinding machines and other equipment, we are able to produce a variety of hard and high-precision
metal-grade progressive dies with stable quality.

[Quality Control Committed to 0PPM ][133]
We have established a rigorous quality management system that spans the entire process. Through
advanced testing equipment and a continuously improving quality management system, we provide our
customers with stable, reliable, and high-quality products.

Custom Service

Fortuna has its own processing equipment for independent product processing, production and
inspection, which greatly speeds up delivery and enhances quality control. It also boasts a
reputable professional after-sales team offering comprehensive services for metal stamping parts.

exported to Japan, USA, Germany, the Czech Republic, Hungary, Norway and other  countries.

[Telecommunication Industry Solutions][191]
Fortuna provides stamping parts and CNC turning parts for data security and intelligent
communication equipment,With the widespread adoption of 5G and the advent of the Internet of
Everything, the communications industry is poised for explosive growth. Customized precision metal
components will evolve from being mere "general-purpose components" to becoming key functional
components that determine equipment performance, reliability, and cost. Customized metal parts are
primarily used in the communications industry in three key sectors: mobile terminals, communications
infrastructure, and consumer communications products. Future development trends favor precision,
intelligence, integration, and environmental friendliness.
[

[Robotics solutions][193]
Future robots will rapidly evolve toward greater intelligence, broader applications, tighter
human-robot collaboration, and more diverse forms. This trend places extremely high demands on the
precision metal components that constitute the robot's "body": higher precision, stronger
reliability, and more complex integration. Simultaneously, the need for high-precision, reliable
components for AI robots is growing daily. As a precision metal stamping expert with over 20 years
of experience, Fortuna is dedicated to providing the crucial precision foundation for innovation. We
supply core metal components for various robotic applications, ensuring the reliability and accuracy
of intelligent movement.

[Sensor metal parts solutions][195]
The core essence of a sensor is signal conversion. It senses target information through directly
measurable components and, through conversion elements, converts non-electrical signals into
processable electrical signals for the system. This signal is ultimately output to a controller
(such as a micro-controller or PLC) or terminal device. From precise control in industrial
automation to intelligent interaction in consumer electronics to real-time monitoring in healthcare,
sensors have become core infrastructure driving the digitalization and intelligentization of various
industries.

## ElFys’ Patented Technology

Most light sensing technologies capture about two thirds of light rays, whereas we can capture all
of them. The Black Silicon Induced Junction Photodiode provides superior sensitivity over wide
spectral range, especially in the ultraviolet as well as ultra-wide viewing angle. Increased
sensitivity provides improvement potential to any applications where light needs to be measured.

[Learn More][61]
~100%
External Quantum Efficency

### Nearly Ideal Photoresponse Over a Wide Spectral Range

Our photodetectors have photoresponse from 200 to 950 nm. The collection efficiency is enhanced by
employing a surface nanostructuring technique combined with an atomic layer deposited coating.

2X
Higher Photoresponse

### Exceptional Photoresponse in The Ultraviolet

The highly effective surface passivation technology eliminates surface recombination. It boosts the
collection efficiency of signal charges generated really close to the photodiode top surface,
yielding over 100% quantum efficiency for ultraviolet light.

60°
Ultra-Wide Sensing Angle

### High Absorbance at Ultra-Wide Sensing Angle 60°

The black silicon surface combined with a tailored atomic layer deposited coating layer greatly
enhances the surface absorbance for an extended range of sensing angles, with single-digit
reflectance up to 1000 nm and 60° incident angle.

## Licensing

At ElFys, Inc., we offer comprehensive intellectual property licensing solutions tailored to meet
your unique business needs. Our team is dedicated to maximizing the value of your IP assets,
ensuring robust protection and strategic partnerships. Let us help you unlock new opportunities and
drive innovation through our  licensing services.

### “Excellent choice for spectroscopy instruments”

We got to know ElFys back in 2019, and since then, we have worked to apply their unique black
silicon photodetector technology into our new developments, such as the new release of our
High-Performance Redstone® OSA302 Spectrum Analyzer. ElFys’ photodetector is an excellent choice for
spectroscopy instruments at short wavelengths.
Our new spectrum analyzer incorporates unique black silicon photodetector technology from ElFys,
delivering superior photosensitivity across a wide spectrum from the UV to NIR. With ElFys’
innovation, Thorlabs’ new instrument boasts an extended wavelength range, low noise, high
resolution, and sensitivity – qualities essential for demanding applications in various fields.

**Olle Rosenqvist**

### “The best customized solution”

ElFys photodetector is a high-end product, which provides excellent photosensitivity, especially on
the lower end of the visible spectrum. Also, the long-term thermal stability of the detector is
outstanding. The co-operation with ElFys to find the best customized solution for us was also very
smooth.

Jukka Lindfors
R&D and Quality Manager

Their nanostructured black silicon technology delivers more than 90% quantum efficiency from deep UV
to NIR with extremely low reflectance and wide angular acceptance. This enabled us to create the
compact LCA-S-400K-BSI photoreceiver — DC to 400 kHz bandwidth, 10⁷ V/A gain, and an ultra-low NEP

## ElFys’ Patented Technology

Most light sensing technologies capture about two thirds of light rays, whereas we can capture all
of them. The Black Silicon Induced Junction Photodiode provides superior sensitivity over wide
spectral range, especially in the ultraviolet as well as ultra-wide viewing angle. Increased
sensitivity provides improvement potential to any applications where light needs to be measured.

[Learn More][61]
~100%
External Quantum Efficency

### Nearly Ideal Photoresponse Over a Wide Spectral Range

Our photodetectors have photoresponse from 200 to 950 nm. The collection efficiency is enhanced by
employing a surface nanostructuring technique combined with an atomic layer deposited coating.

2X
Higher Photoresponse

### Exceptional Photoresponse in The Ultraviolet

The highly effective surface passivation technology eliminates surface recombination. It boosts the
collection efficiency of signal charges generated really close to the photodiode top surface,
yielding over 100% quantum efficiency for ultraviolet light.

60°
Ultra-Wide Sensing Angle

### High Absorbance at Ultra-Wide Sensing Angle 60°

The black silicon surface combined with a tailored atomic layer deposited coating layer greatly
enhances the surface absorbance for an extended range of sensing angles, with single-digit
reflectance up to 1000 nm and 60° incident angle.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

[IPC-255: International Standard for Digital Twins][186] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020

This standard establishes the IPC Digital Twin, which is comprised of the Digital Twin Product,
Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle frameworks. Within the Digital Twin
Architecture, this standard stipulates and defines Digital Twin properties, types, complexities and
readiness levels. The IPC Digital Twin includes historical information about a product, including
the history of design in terms of revision and engineering changes, and manufacturing information,
that many refer to as the Digital Thread.

This standard enables any manufacturer, design organization or solution provider to initiate
application interoperability to create smart value chains, as well as the mechanism to assess their
current IPC Digital Twin readiness level.

This standard provides the information and guidance necessary to understand a full IPC Digital Twin,
Digital Twin Product, Digital Twin Manufacturing and Digital Twin Lifecycle. This standard also
provides information and guidance on how organizations benefit from the IPC Digital Twin, how to
assess IPC Digital Twin readiness level and how to prepare an organization of any size or production
volume to implement a full IPC Digital Twin approach to its organization and/or products.

[ISO TR 4804, Road vehicles: Safety and cybersecurity for automated driving systems, Design,
verification and validation][187] Revision: • Published 12/01/0020
This document describes steps for developing and validating automated driving systems based on basic
safety principles derived from worldwide applicable publications. It considers safety- and
cybersecurity-by-design, as well as verification and validation methods for automated driving
systems focused on vehicles with level 3 and level 4 features according to SAE J3016: 2018. In
addition, it outlines cybersecurity considerations intersecting with objectives for safety of
automated driving systems.

To date our community has made over 100 million downloads. It’s based on principles of collaboration, unobstructed discovery, and, most importantly, scientific progression. As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. [Authors, Editors and Institutions][10] We are a community of more than 103,000 authors and editors from 3,291 institutions spanning 160 countries, including Nobel Prize winners and some of the world’s most-cited researchers. Publishing on IntechOpen allows authors to earn citations and find new collaborators, meaning more people see your work not only from your own field of study, but from other related fields too. This milestone comes shortly after the 20th anniversary of the publication of our first OA book. [Read more][78] 18 December 2025 ##### 20 Years of Open Access Books: A Milestone for IntechOpen Over the past two decades, IntechOpen has grown into a global leader in open access book publishing, with an ever-expanding catalogue covering STM, as well as the social sciences and humanities. This milestone reflects not only the company’s achievements but also the growing recognition of open access books as a vital model for academic publishing, contributing to the transformation of how knowledge is shared worldwide. [Read more][79] 16 October 2025 ##### IntechOpen Among First Publishers to Go Live with OA Switchboard Books Solution We are proud to announce that IntechOpen is among the first three publishers, alongside Cambridge University Press and University of Michigan Press, to go live with the OA Switchboard Books Solution. [Read more][80] 23 April 2025 ##### IntechOpen Marked 7,500th OA Book Release with 'Climate Policies,' Co-edited by Members of ##### Nobel Peace Prize-Winning IPCC Team Co-edited by Gary Yohe and Joel Smith, senior members of the 2007 Nobel Peace Prize-winning Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), this timely volume offers a comprehensive evaluation of contemporary climate policy strategies. [Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][82] 08 July 2024 ##### IntechOpen Presents Interviews for Young Scientists with Science's Leading Minds We are pleased to present a series of inspirational interviews for young researchers with some of today's leading scientists, ranging from a Nobel laureate to pioneers and innovators in various fields, including pharmacogenomics, pharmaceutical leadership, and academia. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. # Laser Lines

Laser Lines is one of the UK’s leading suppliers of 3D printers, additive manufacturing systems,
laser processing solutions, laser photonics products and associated accessories. Representing over
20 suppliers of proven technology, our experienced sales and support teams offer an end-to-end
service which includes training, installation, maintenance and repair services for all of our
products. Our customers come from sectors as diverse as university research, automotive production,
tooling manufacturing and product design

scientific lasers, accessories, 3D printers and additive manufacturing systems. Our experienced
support team offers training, installation, maintenance and repair services for all our products. We
also have a 3D printer facility for bench mark pieces and other requirements.

][50]

We offer direct support from our experienced engineers. They can assist with product selection,

][51]

ensuring the reliability and performance of all our products.

on your specific technical requirements and performance goals.

We primarily serve the medical, industrial, measurement, and security sectors, providing
high-performance solutions for a wide range of demanding applications.

###### Common Questions

## Common Questions About Our Photodetector Solutions

[ What products do you offer?
][48]

We specialize in photodiodes, X-ray detectors, and integrated modules. We also excel in creating
custom-designed solutions for specific OEM application needs.

[ What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
][49]
* MOQ varies by product. For custom projects, we work with you to find a practical solution. Please
  contact us for details on your specific needs.
[ What kind of technical support is available?
][50]

We offer direct support from our experienced engineers. They can assist with product selection,
integration, and any troubleshooting you may encounter along the way.

[ How do I request a quote?
][51]

Simply use the "Request a Quote" form on our website or email us directly. Our team will respond
promptly with detailed pricing and lead time information.

[ Do you ship products internationally?
][52]

Yes, we have extensive experience with global logistics and ship our products to customers
worldwide. We handle all necessary shipping documentation for a smooth process.

[ Do you work under an NDA?
][53]

Yes, we understand the importance of confidentiality for our clients' projects. We routinely work
under Non-Disclosure Agreements to protect your intellectual property.

[ How does the customization process work?
][54]

It begins with a technical consultation, followed by design, prototyping, and mass production. Our
engineers will guide you through every step of the process.

[ Can I get samples for testing?
][55]

Yes, we provide samples of our standard components for evaluation. Please contact our sales team to
discuss your project and specific sample requirements.

[ What are your typical lead times?
][56]

Lead times depend on the product and order volume. Standard parts ship faster than custom solutions.
We will provide a clear delivery schedule with your quote.

[ Are your products certified?
][57]

Yes, we adhere to strict quality standards and hold key industry certifications, such as ISO 9001,
ensuring the reliability and performance of all our products.

[ Can you help me choose a detector?
][58]

Absolutely. Our application engineers can recommend the best standard part or custom solution based
on your specific technical requirements and performance goals.

[ What industries do you primarily serve?
][59]

We primarily serve the medical, industrial, measurement, and security sectors, providing
high-performance solutions for a wide range of demanding applications.

Top 5 Reasons your Vias Cause your High Speed Signals to Fail
Your traces look good. Your connections look perfect. But your high speed board still fails channel
analysis. In this video, EE design consultant Kirsch Mackey counts down the top 5 via mistakes that
quietly wreck high speed signals, and shows you exactly how to fix each one. Vias aren't just
vertical connections through the board. At high speeds and short rise times, they're discontinuities
for the electromagnetic wave. Manage them wrong, and your channel signals can fail even when the
layout looks flawless. In this video: 00:00 – Intro: why vias fail even when everything else looks

[SAN-U Optronics: Mass production of isolators for 800G/1.6T transceiver][106]

rotators with domestically produced ones, successfully achieving automated mass production of
optical isolators. This ensures stable capacity and performance of isolators, and has already been
validated by leading transceiver manufacturers.

Self developed chip high reliability detector product matrix SAN-U Optronics: Heavy Release of Self
Developed Photodiode Chips and Series Devices Recently, SAN-U Optronics'
self-developed Photodiode chip and series of devices were officially released, marking our company's
promotion of domestic substitution of key optical devices in the field of optical communication. As
a key link in the optical communication industry chain, PD chips are known as the "translator of
optical signals", and their performance directly determines the transmission efficiency and
reliability of optical communication systems. Based on the technological breakthrough of
self-developed PD chips, SAN-U Optronics has launched four major product matrices: MiniPD series,
tail fiber PD (adhesive/laser welding), TapPD series, and arrayed PD devices. With the dual
advantages of "diversified product types+domestic chip substitution", the products are mainly used
in the fields of fiber amplifiers, optical power meters, optical signal data transmission, and
optical sensing. Self developed Photodiode chip and series device product Series ① SAN-U
self-developed Photodiode chip The Photodiode self-developed chip adopts a PIN structure design,
which has ultra-low dark current, high reliability, and low voltage operation characteristics. The
working temperature range covers -40~+85 ℃, meeting the stable operation requirements in extreme
environments. ② Mini Photodiode series The Mini Photodiode series products have a minimum diameter
of 1.2mm and are equipped with high-precision and highly reliable gas sealing technology. While the
size is reduced, the devices still have high performance and reliability. Mainly used in high-speed
optical communication (high-speed fiber optic transceiver modules, fiber optic amplifiers), optical
sensing systems (oil well monitoring, power equipment temperature measurement, perimeter security),
industrial and military, aerospace and other high-end application fields. ③ Photodiode with pigtail
series The SAN-U Optronics  PD with pigtail series products have constructed a product matrix
covering multiple scenarios through process differentiation design, using two packaging processes of
adhesive and laser welding to accurately match different application needs. The adhesive process
relies on an automated mass production system to achieve low-cost and high-efficiency production,
especially suitable for cost sensitive large-scale scenarios such as optical communication
equipment; The laser welding process uses gold tin eutectic welding technology to form stable
connections through intermetallic compound bonding, which can meet the strict reliability
requirements of industrial applications. This product can be widely used in fields such as optical
communication and fiber optic sensing. ④ The TapPD series The TapPD series of products integrates a
splitter and a detector into a compact package, enabling real-time, non-destructive sampling and
monitoring of optical signals without interrupting the main optical path signal transmission, thus
ensuring stable signal transmission. The products are primarily used in fiber optic communication
transmitters, fiber optic amplifiers, optical power meters, medical lasers, and other fields. ⑤ The
ArrayPD device series   The ArrayPD device series, through its array design, achieves higher
detection efficiency and faster response speed. This product is suitable for high-end applications
such as lidar and medical imaging, providing strong technical support for the development of related
industries. CORE PARAMETERS COMPARISON After extensive testing and comparison between SAN-U's
self-developed Photodiode chip and well-known foreign chips, as well as customer testing and
feedback, it is found that SAN-U's chip has lower dark current compared to foreign Photodiode chips,
while other parameters and performance are on par or better than those of foreign chips.

Developed Photodiode Chips and Series Devices Recently, SAN-U Optronics'

promotion of domestic substitution of key optical devices in the field of optical communication. As
a key link in the optical communication industry chain, PD chips are known as the "translator of
optical signals", and their performance directly determines the transmission efficiency and
reliability of optical communication systems. Based on the technological breakthrough of
self-developed PD chips, SAN-U Optronics has launched four major product matrices: MiniPD series,
tail fiber PD (adhesive/laser welding), TapPD series, and arrayed PD devices. With the dual
advantages of "diversified product types+domestic chip substitution", the products are mainly used
in the fields of fiber amplifiers, optical power meters, optical signal data transmission, and
optical sensing. Self developed Photodiode chip and series device product Series ① SAN-U
self-developed Photodiode chip The Photodiode self-developed chip adopts a PIN structure design,
which has ultra-low dark current, high reliability, and low voltage operation characteristics. The
working temperature range covers -40~+85 ℃, meeting the stable operation requirements in extreme
environments. ② Mini Photodiode series The Mini Photodiode series products have a minimum diameter
of 1.2mm and are equipped with high-precision and highly reliable gas sealing technology. While the
size is reduced, the devices still have high performance and reliability. Mainly used in high-speed
optical communication (high-speed fiber optic transceiver modules, fiber optic amplifiers), optical
sensing systems (oil well monitoring, power equipment temperature measurement, perimeter security),
industrial and military, aerospace and other high-end application fields. ③ Photodiode with pigtail
series The SAN-U Optronics  PD with pigtail series products have constructed a product matrix
covering multiple scenarios through process differentiation design, using two packaging processes of
adhesive and laser welding to accurately match different application needs. The adhesive process
relies on an automated mass production system to achieve low-cost and high-efficiency production,
especially suitable for cost sensitive large-scale scenarios such as optical communication
equipment; The laser welding process uses gold tin eutectic welding technology to form stable
connections through intermetallic compound bonding, which can meet the strict reliability
requirements of industrial applications. This product can be widely used in fields such as optical
communication and fiber optic sensing. ④ The TapPD series The TapPD series of products integrates a
splitter and a detector into a compact package, enabling real-time, non-destructive sampling and
monitoring of optical signals without interrupting the main optical path signal transmission, thus
ensuring stable signal transmission. The products are primarily used in fiber optic communication
transmitters, fiber optic amplifiers, optical power meters, medical lasers, and other fields. ⑤ The
ArrayPD device series   The ArrayPD device series, through its array design, achieves higher
detection efficiency and faster response speed. This product is suitable for high-end applications
such as lidar and medical imaging, providing strong technical support for the development of related
industries. CORE PARAMETERS COMPARISON After extensive testing and comparison between SAN-U's

## Sensor solutions for repeated industrial automation tasks

XSZ sensors are used where machines need stable detection signals in compact, fast-moving or harsh
production conditions.

### Packaging Lines

Carton, bottle, bag, film, label and color mark detection.

### Machine Tools

Metal part position, tool detection, fixture checking and end-position feedback.

### Automated Assembly

Small part counting, missing-part checks, feeder monitoring and station verification.

### Logistics & Conveyors

Object presence, counting, sorting, spacing and reject station detection.

### Food & Beverage

Bottle, cap, label, liquid level and packaging presence detection.

### Robotics

End position, gripper checks, part presence and compact sensor installation.

### Safety Guarding

Light curtain protection for press, cutting, packing and handling machines.

### OEM Equipment

Custom cable, connector, label, wiring and package support for repeat production.
